paper.title_en: Photon Rings and Mass-Independent Observables of a Five-Dimensional Charged AdS Black Hole
paper.abstract_en: We investigate the optical properties of a five-dimensional charged anti-de Sitter (AdS) black hole. Using the null geodesic equations, we determine the event horizon and photon sphere radii and the critical impact parameter, showing that all decrease with increasing charge, while the photon sphere radius remains independent of the AdS radius. To avoid dependence on the mass scale and the observer-dependent apparent size of the shadow in an AdS spacetime, we introduce two mass-independent geometric observables: the subring exponent $γ$ and the ratio of the critical impact parameter to that of the direct image of the innermost stable circular orbit (ISCO). We derive $γ$ in closed form and show that it is independent of the AdS radius and satisfies $2π/\sqrt{3}<γ\leqπ\sqrt{2}$, above the values for four-dimensional Schwarzschild and Reissner--Nordström black holes. Using a Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) forecast based on noiseless mock data with illustrative fractional uncertainties of $5\%$, we find that the dimensionless AdS radius can be constrained with a relative uncertainty of $16$--$19\%$, whereas the charge can be distinguished from zero only for the near-extremal fiducial model considered. Under these assumptions, the subring exponent provides a Gaussian separation of $3.4$--$5.9σ$ from the four-dimensional Schwarzschild black hole.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文研究五维带电AdS黑洞的光子环与光子球，导出质量无关的几何可观测量的闭式表达，并结合MCMC参数预测，理论分析较为自洽且结构清晰；虽属黑洞几何/引力基础方向，与核心主题相关度中等，但深度与可读性足以支持进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 五维带电AdS黑洞的光子环与质量无关可观测量的研究
decision.abstract_zh: 我们研究了一个五维带电反德西特（AdS）黑洞的光学性质。利用零测地线方程，我们确定了事件视界半径、光子球半径以及临界碰撞参数，并表明它们均随电荷增大而减小，而光子球半径保持与AdS半径无关。为避免依赖于质量标度以及AdS时空中阴影的依赖于观测者的视尺寸，我们引入两个质量无关的几何可观测量：子环指数 $γ$ 以及临界碰撞参数与最内稳定圆轨道（ISCO）直接像对应值之比。我们以闭式推导出 $γ$，并表明它独立于AdS半径且满足 $2π/\sqrt{3}<γ\leqπ\sqrt{2}$，高于四维Schwarzschild与Reissner--Nordström黑洞的取值。基于无噪声模拟数据（取5\%的示例性相对不确定度）的马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）预测，我们发现无量纲AdS半径可以以16--19\%的相对不确定度被约束，而电荷仅对近极端基准模型能够与零区分。在这些假设下，子环指数相对四维Schwarzschild黑洞可提供3.4--5.9σ的高斯分离度。
